title: POV: leopard with 300 neighbours per km²

scenes.headline: POV: you're a leopard in India and your neighbours are farmers
You keep a low profile. Very low.

scenes.label: people per km² in leopard-occupied Maharashtra farmland

scenes.headline: About 5 adult leopards per 100 km², and attacks on people were rare
scenes.body: Coexistence is possible, which is why landscapes outside reserves matter for big cats.

caption:
Your next-door neighbour might be spotted.

The same study found striped hyenas at a similar density: about 10 large carnivores per 100 km² sharing a completely human-modified landscape. The clip shows a wild leopard in Uttarakhand.

Source: Athreya et al. 2013, PLOS ONE.  Photos/video: Wikimedia Commons (credits on screen).
notes: POV role-play that turns into a real Indian conservation finding (leopards in dense farmland), shot over a wild Uttarakhand leopard clip; on-brand for a Bengaluru nature-ed account.
